newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Strike planned at Philips plant from Monday.
newsitem.headline: Strike planned at Philips plant from Monday.

text.p: Workers at a Philips' factory will begin a strike on Monday after the breakdown of talks between unions and management over restructuring at the plant, a Philips spokesman said on Sunday.
The factory at Hoogeveen in the eastern Netherlands employs about 1,000 workers and produces vacuum cleaners and coffee makers.
"(The unions) wanted a guarantee that there will be no job losses: Philips cannot give that absolute guarantee. They told us that there would be a strike from Monday morning," said the spokesman.

The dispute is the result of Philips plans to scale down the Hoogeveen plant and move some of the production to a plant in Poland. Dutch media speculate Philips wishes to cut half of the workforce at the Dutch plant.
"Philips simply hasn't come towards us," Dutch ANP news agency quoted a union spokesman as saying.
At the end of September last year, Philips' total global workforce stood at 274,000.
